description: Main bearded caveman: thick black outline, big round nose, yellow leopard-spot tunic. Redrawn per pose/expression (laugh, whisper, point, worried, smug hands-on-hips, shrug, stink thumbs-up, OK sign, warm at fire, club scratch).
Tiny hunched caveman centre in empty frame.
Woman with black bob hair, leopard strapless dress, hand on hip winking and waving. Same drawing re-used (opening two-shot, solo, later reminder) with expression swaps to disgust and anger.
Woman arms crossed angry; G0174 looks the same as G0084 but reuse vs redraw not confirmed.
Woman surprised open mouth pointing at fire.
Woman in dance/hip pose frowning beside the brain.
Waving woman body with no head.
Grey-shaded woman hands on hips scowling, opposite caveman.
Old wrinkled woman sad, standing in trash can.
Woman smiling and waving within tree-crown cloud on white trunk; caveman reaches toward her.
Row of 8 women/men variants (redhead, curly, bob, ponytail, heart-hands, peace sign, small man) around large grinning caveman.
Grumpy caveman carrying screaming spiky-haired figure over shoulder.
Caveman with club mid-run chasing white shaggy mammoth.
Caveman holding club, scratching head, spiky hair.
Extreme close-up grinning face, dense cross-hatching.
Charcoal-dark hulking silhouette with glowing eyes, then dark angry close-up.
Caveman in yellow leopard suit eyes closed gesturing, under red title, standing on a ground line.
Caveman bust at table line, hands clasped, serious.
Crayon-line stick figures: roaring caveman (arms up) and ponytail woman hands on hips; caveman scaled up in G0060-G0061.
Caveman lying prone on bed with phone, laughing.
Kneeling figure covering face (same small scale as CAVEMAN_SMALL_SAD).
Caveman face in tree trunk, crown with five apples then bare; grin to scowl.
Slouched seated caveman in black cave arch; close-up wide-eyed variant.
Caveman with spear walking, scowl; same drawing held while goal swaps to mushroom.
Caveman arms out at campfire, and blue glowing translucent version.
Caveman bowler hat, bow tie, daisy, frown.
Shrugging caveman body with face erased (white oval in beard mass); from same body as G0112 hold, redrawn face.
Stern caveman in white log/fur garment with vertical lines, two chest marks added later.
Caveman shouting, pointing at easel board 'HOT?'.
Caveman with black gorilla fur chest-beating.
Caveman falling past cliff edge, arms up; drops out of frame in 39 steps.
Sunglasses and leather-jacket caveman walking with woman, heart above her.
Caveman typing at stone desk, shouting.
Caveman eyes closed hearts, clasped hands; identical composition used twice with a brain at right.
Caveman shocked with sweat and hand to cheek, beside headless woman and brain.
Caveman in sunglasses frowning next to brain, then frozen blue arms-crossed version.
Caveman chasing crying woman, 3 run poses seen.
Caveman on back with X eyes; later with rock and bottle.
Caveman and woman cuddled, eyes closed over small fire. Looks re-used identically at two times; not pixel-verified.
Smiling couple carrying logs, ending image.
Walking nose with face and limbs: thumbs-up smile, then shocked hands-up.
Wigged judge with gavel and bell.
Moustached man pulling rabbit from top hat.
Smiling brain with arms and legs, walking.
Line-drawn side-view brain; appears at right in several scenes, smaller or tilted in some.
Leaping fish, then larger grumpy fish with spear.
White shaggy mammoth with curled tusk.
Smiley-head stick through red heart, then sad-face spearhead.
Red heart with yellow flames on top.
Red-orange flame on logs; re-used in warm, woman-pointing and couple scenes.
White football goal swapped for white spotted mushroom.
Grey metal bin, empty then occupied.
Tripod easel with framed photo-like creature image labelled 'HOT?'; photo is only photographic-look element in a drawn scene.
Round bushy tree gaining 1 to 5 black berries one at a time.
Outlined block arrow right then left, beside winking woman.
Speckled rock changes to ring with hole; tipped bottle appears.
White cliff outline at right edge, static during fall.
Black cave arch with crayon-like ticks.
Flat white background used for nearly every segment, including blank white beats.
Near-black cross-hatched crayon background and shading; only dark-palette beat.
Full-frame greyscale painted/photoreal weeping caveman; no cartoon outline.
Black bold rounded hand-lettered all-caps, built word by word on white card, large relative to frame.
Red bold lettering: 'KrudTalks' title and 'MISSION:' heading.
Small black caps 'HOT?' on easel card.
Wavy vertical lines around thumbs-up caveman.
Blue translucent glow and floor shadow on soul figure; blue tint and ice on frozen figure.
Small heart icons, sweat drops, motion ticks near characters.
Charcoal/crayon texture line style for stick figures and dark scenes.
